name: MonoSwap
technique: Social Engineering; Malware; Private Key Compromise
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the RevertIQ label and description.
rootCause: MonoSwap’s July 23, 2024 social-engineering compromise on Blast exposed wallets and contracts after a developer installed phishing software during a fake VC call, leading to a reported $1.3M loss from staked liquidity. A developer installed phishing software during a fake venture-capital call, and that malware ran on an office machine that could access MonoSwap wallets and contracts. The public record does not establish a multisig or hardware-wallet barrier, so endpoint compromise became protocol control.
